scientific_integrity: No empirical test is represented as a proof; all prior definitions and general asymptotic results are credited. Earliest date is the MFCS 2006 printed-proceedings publication date (11 August 2006), rather than the later 2007 journal date.
scientific_limitations: Only the precisely defined exhaustive-history parsing of generalized Cantor fixed points is proved; a different overlap or dictionary convention need not have these boundaries. The proof is infinite and structural; enumerations are corroboration. A closely related but differently defined factorization source was only available at abstract level. An independent scientific audit has not been performed.
title: Exact exhaustive Lempel–Ziv phrase boundaries of generalized Cantor words
